Name: Sheraton Stockholm
Company description: The Sheraton Stockholm Hotel is located in the very heart of Stockholm’s central business district, shopping areas, and attractions – Perfect for both business and leisure guests.  The hotel offers stunning views of Lake Mälaren, City Hall, and Old Town. Whether you are on business or pleasure you will enjoy your stay with us. We have a wide range of rooms and suites, a restaurant and bar in which to dine or relax with friends. Our concierge is available to make sure that you get the most out of your stay in Stockholm. We are located; a two-minute walk from the Old Town and moments away from shopping and night life. The Arlanda Express only takes 20 minutes from the airport, and arrives at the Central Station, a one-minute walk from the hotel. Underground secure-parking is located in direct conjunction with the hotel with a lift that takes you directly to lobby level.

Name: KONTORET
Company description: Kontoret erbjuder moderna och flexibla kontorslösningar på fyra strategiskt utvalda platser i Stockholm: Nybroviken på Östermalm, Globen, Solna Centrum och Alviks Strand. Varje kontor är noggrant placerat för att ge optimal tillgänglighet med både bil och kollektivtrafik, samtidigt som de erbjuder inspirerande och funktionella arbetsmiljöer för företag i alla storlekar. Sedan 1996 har vi specialiserat oss på att leverera högkvalitativa kontorslösningar med full service. Vi erbjuder privata kontor, fasta platser och medlemskap, där du får tillgång till bemannad reception, konferensrum, dygnet-runt-öppettider, kaffe och te, samt concierge service. Dessutom kan vi bistå med tjänster som budservice, kemtvätt och IT-support, så att du kan fokusera på din verksamhet medan vi tar hand om detaljerna. Våra kontor har unika fördelar: Kontoret Nybroviken: Beläget på Birger Jarlsgatan, med närhet till både Stureplan och Nybrokajen, erbjuder detta kontor en exklusiv arbetsmiljö mitt i centrala Stockholm. Kontoret Globen: På 12:e våningen med panoramautsikt över Stockholm, får du en inspirerande arbetsplats nära stadens södra knutpunkt. Kontoret Solna Centrum: Perfekt för den som vill ha nära till både centrala Stockholm och alla fördelar Solna erbjuder, med direkt tillgång till handel och service. Kontoret Alviks Strand: Här arbetar du i lugnet vid vattnet med fantastisk utsikt över Mälaren, en idealisk plats för både fokus och kreativitet. Med oss får du ett kontor som anpassas efter dina behov, med flexibilitet att byta rum eller anpassa tjänster när företaget växer. Vi är här för att skapa en arbetsmiljö där du trivs och kan utvecklas.

Name: Les Clefs D'Or Sweden
Company description: SHPF (Svenska Hotell Portier Föreningen) is the world’s oldest association of its kind and, from its founding in 1926, it has served to foster interest in the hotel industry and to increase the level of service in each hotel. The association is for those who work with guest and customer contact in hotels throughout Sweden. Our international members are all members of Les Clefs d’Or International and are concierge who work at many of the best hotels in Sweden. Easily identified by the golden crossed keys on their lapels, these members are an elite fraternity, globally connected, committed to professional development, and driven to setting new standards for guest service perfection. Among our national members are concierge, front desk staff or who hold other positions in the hotel service sector with guest contact. Through the SHPF – Les Clefs d’Or Sweden you will be able to meet industry colleagues in casual settings to exchange experiences and learn from each other. In addition, it will broaden your network of contacts, both nationally and internationally, which benefits the hotels, its guests and, above all, your personal development – an investment in your future!

Name: Prettyclose
Company description: Prettyclose is a high-end social lifestyle network where you share and receive travel inspiration from the best destinations around the world. Each destination includes travel guides, insider tips, top hotels, restaurants, nightlife, shopping, culture and much more. Find ideas about where to stay, what to eat and do. Make seamless reservations though the app and our concierge.  Customize your personal menu by choosing the categories you're most interested in. Follow guides and create your own, share them with friends and followers. Rate places and share experiences with other people in your network.  Make the most of your travel!

Name: Travel Concept
Company description: Vårt team av experter hjälper dig med skräddarsydda resor världen över. Idag kan det vara svårt att hitta tid till allt man både vill och måste göra. Det är tidskrävande att boka en resa, särskilt om du vill att den ska nå ens önskemål och förväntningar. Vår mångåriga erfarenhet och goda kontakter ger dig även trygghet och kvalitetssäkring i valet av resmål och leverantörer. Vi skräddarsyr hela resan åt dig, helt efter dina önskemål. Skulle något hända under resan finns vi med längs vägen, vi är ett samtal bort. Som enda resebyrå i Sverige har vi ett unikt samarbete med Quintessentially, världens ledande conciergeservice, så att du har tillgång till den bästa biljetterna, restaurangerna och mycket mer. Our team of experts helps you with tailor-made journeys around the world. In today's fast-paced world, finding time to manage everything you want and need to do can be challenging. Planning the perfect trip is often time-consuming, particularly when aiming to meet specific preferences and expectations. With years of experience and a vast network of trusted contacts, we ensure you receive the highest level of quality and peace of mind when selecting destinations. We handle every detail of your journey, fully tailored to your desires. Should any issues arise during your trip, we're always just a phone call away. As the only travel agency in Sweden with an exclusive partnership with Quintessentially, the world’s leading concierge service, we provide you access to the finest tickets, restaurants, and so much more.

Name: Grow Internationals
Company description: Grow Internationals support companies and organizations with international talents in Sweden. We are specialized supporting spouses and accompanying family members that are crucial for the wellbeing of the expat family and successful international assignments. We deliver a full service package post-relocation with extensive coverage for the needs of a organization's international assignees. The services include: - Language Training - Cross-cultural Training - Career support and Job coaching  - Social events and networks - Concierge service for expat families Our member companies and organizations can be assured that their international assignees with families are well taken care of during their time in Sweden. We connect and support expats and international talents in Sweden. We grow language, culture, career and social networks.

Name: Stockholms Medicus
Company description: Vi är Stockholms mest centrala plastikkirurgmottagning med Sveriges bredaste sortiment av livsförbättrande behandlingar och ingrepp.  Hos oss möts du av stora, vackra och välkomnande miljöer, med de senaste behandlingsmetoderna och de senaste behandlingsteknikerna både inom kosmetisk plastikkirurgi och kosmetiska klinikbehandlingar. Tillgänglig och erfaren personal tar hand om dig vid ditt besök och borgar för ett exakt och precist resultat. Vår strävan är att erbjuda så effektiva behandlingar som möjligt, med så kort återhämtningstid som möjligt och till så vettigt pris som möjligt. Via vår concierge får du ekonomiska muskler att förverkliga din investering i dig själv -  hos oss får du en räntefri krediter om du önskar. Verksamheten arbetar med tillstånd av Socialstyrelsen och du hittar oss granne med Mood - livsstilsgallerian i hjärtat av Stockholm. Välkommen in på vår hemsida www.stomed.se och läs mer om våra olika behandlingar - och ingrepp, ta del av våra före- och efterbilder och håll dig uppdaterad via våra flöden på bloggen, Facebook och Instagram.

Name: Tailor Events
Company description: Tailor Events is a one-stop-shop for your access to exclusive events, experiences, entertainment and conferences. Together with you, we create experiences beyond the ordinary. In the summer of 2006, just before the FIFA World Cup in Germany, Tailor Events launched from a small office in London and a rented desk in Stockholm. The founders had for several years earlier built an expertise in corporate events and travel with a huge contact network. The founders were firmly convinced that there was a market for a player who could deliver events out of the ordinary and the company soon became renowned for its ability to always be willing to go the extra mile. Everyone at Tailor Events frequently travels the globe to find the greatest stadium seats, best hotels, trendiest restaurants, and the most popular night clubs and top conference destinations. With different backgrounds and expertise within our organization, we ensure a unique experience with quality in every detail. Personal Service - We come to know our customers and their preferences. Do not be surprised if after a while we know the tickets and events you prefer. We always deliver tickets in person directly to your hotel and you can always reach us at our 24/7 Concierge Service. Value for Money - We buy in large quantities to the world’s most exclusive events. Great purchasing power, combined with strong relationships enables us to always offer you a competitive price. Tailor Events - Your One-Stop-Shop
